transc:

The steamers should be ordered to
Alexan dry schooners & barges to
Hammock Virtue G. D Wise Asst
Vinton is on his way to

You will consult him & take
up all light draft steamers which
you can procure in addition to
those already in service and despatch
them to Pagoda usual terms of
charter to be adhered to Telegraph
daily progress pause These are all
for Shafford service We need such
a fleet as we had in

shoe lay but not quite so
large signed Me Eggs Vinton Vermin
